concerns.text: Task T009 conditionally skips the bootstrap mediation analysis (FR-006) and its reporting (FR-007) when the measured‑stress row count is < 50, citing a power‑analysis threshold. The specification only permits skipping mediation when *no* measured residual stress is available (edge case), not when the sample size is merely insufficient. This constitutes a semantic weakening of FR-006/FR-007, violating the requirement that mediation analysis must be executed on the measured‑stress subset.
